name: Tyler Pitchford, Esq.
biography: holds degrees in Software Architecture from New College of Florida and a Juris Doctor from the Stetson University College of Law. He co-founded the Azureus Bittorrent client in 2003 and currently works as CTO for Digome, LLC in Nashville, TN. His work experience includes the Florida State Attorney's office, the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida, and the Florida Supreme Court. Tyler has previously presented at PhreakNic, Outerz0ne, and Shmoocon. Additionally, he has taught several courses on computer programming and security throughout the years.
